headline: Wall Street trades mixed and is set for its worst week since April 2025
summary: The Nasdaq lost more than 2% as Anthropic's stock market debut failed to restore momentum in Nvidia and the battered technology sector. Wall Street is heading for its worst week since April 2025.
why: The Nasdaq Composite is a major US equity index heavily weighted toward technology companies, and Nvidia is a leading supplier of AI chips. Sharp moves in these names often shape broader US equity sentiment.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The input says the technology sector, including Nvidia, was hit and failed to recover momentum.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The input says Anthropic's IPO did not restore momentum in Nvidia and the battered technology sector, leaving the Nasdaq down more than 2%.
original_headline: Wall Street opera mixto y perfila peor semana desde abril de 2025
